violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: MILK AT 47F IN 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR/FREEZER (HARVEST GLEN).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC TRANSFERRED MILK TO FREEZER FOR RAPID COOLING TO 41F; PIC ADJUSTED UNIT TEMPERATURE TO 41F DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE REFRIGERATION UNITS ARE ADJUSTED TO OPERATE BETWEEN 34-38F TO ALLOW TCS FOODS TO BE MAINTAINED AT 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED PAINT CHIPPING ON AIR VENTS IN KITCHEN CEILING.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed dust surrounding air vents in kitchen ceiling.
violations.corrective_action: Clean air vents and surrounding ceiling area.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. Observed no handwashing signage in all four houses handsinks.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. CFM will provided handwashing signage for all houses appropriated for the facility.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Equipment food-contact surfaces/utensils were not observed cleaned before any possible contamination. Observed ice scooper dirty stored in the drawer of the service table.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned at any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred. CFM removed the ice scooper and placed it in the wash compartment for proper cleaning.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Equipment food-contact surfaces/utensils were not observed cleaned before any possible contamination. Observed food debris and residue on the toaster, indicating it had not been properly cleaned.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned at any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred. Toaster was cleaned and sanitized during the inspection.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Due to improper operation of the hot water, mechanical warewashing machine, the thermolabel did not turn black, indicating that food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized. Observed final rinse temperature of the heat-sanitizing dish machine at Dockside location measuring 152°F, and at Berryridge location measuring 159°F using irreversible thermometer. (Dish temp).
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: Observed can opener rusted.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CFM will removed the rust or provide a new can opener.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: Observed that the temperature control on the oven was not functioning properly; temperature could not be adjusted as needed.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Oven will be removed from service until repaired or replaced to ensure proper temperature control for safe food preparation.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F:Unit # 5 at 43 F
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CFM will adjust/repaired unit # 5 to 41F or below

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: Observed that three out of four lightbulbs in the hood extractor were either not functioning or blinking
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Bulbs will be replaced to ensure adequate lighting for safe food preparation and equipment cleaning.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: Observed a white, mold-like film on the left interior wall of the walk-in refrigerator
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. CFM will clean and sanitize the affected area. Staff were instructed to increase the frequency of cleaning inside the walk-in unit to prevent mold growth and ensure sanitary conditions.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling tiles in the kitchen and mop sink room with black, mold-like spots are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Ceiling tiles will be cleaned and assessed for potential replacement.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Due to improper operation of the hot water, mechanical warewashing machine, the thermolabel did not turn black, indicating that food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized. Observed heat sanitizing dish machine in Harvest Glen at 127F using irreversible thermometer. Observed heat sanitizing dish machines in Berry Ridge at 150F using irreversible thermometer.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. CFM will discontinue use of both dish machines and route all soiled dishware to other working dish machines. CFM will place work order for machines to be repaired. EHS will follow up with CFM in 3 days to see if more time is needed for repair.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: Observed 3 compartment sink hot water temperature at 101-103F.
violations.corrective_action: The water source and system shall be of sufficient capacity to meet the peak water demands of the food establishment. CFM will place work order to adjust hot water at 3 compartment sink. EHS will follow up within 10 days.
